headerDisplay: HomeKit control of an MG EV via the SAIC iSmart cloud API. Only one iSmart session is allowed at a time, so logging in here will sign the phone app out.
footerDisplay: Set the account password via the MG_SAIC_PASSWORD environment variable instead of pasting it into this form where possible, so it doesn't sit unencrypted in config.json on the NAS.

password.title: iSmart account password
password.description: Leave blank and set MG_SAIC_PASSWORD in the Homebridge environment instead, if possible.

vin.title: Vehicle VIN (optional)
vin.description: Leave blank to use the first vehicle returned by the account. Set this if the account ever returns more than one vehicle, to pin the plugin to the primary MG4.

pollIntervalMinutes.title: Poll interval (minutes)
pollIntervalMinutes.description: SAIC's gateway can pause an account for 15 minutes if it sees too many logins. 15 minutes is the documented safe default.

enableDoorSensors.title: Expose door / boot / bonnet contact sensors
